data.description: Private Beach Access | Expansive Sea View | Supreme Luxury
data.long_description:
Discover the pinnacle of luxury at Como Residences, an architectural marvel by Nakheel Properties. Rising 75 stories into the sky, this spectacular tower, shaped like an organic seashell, is a symbol of refined elegance and sophistication. A series of vertical lakes and a stunning rooftop landscape pool on the 71st floor are just a few of the exceptional features that set this development apart. The 360-degree rooftop observation deck, the highest on Palm Jumeirah, offers breathtaking views of the city.

The development offers 76 exclusive residences, including 2-6 bedroom apartments, 7-bedroom duplexes, and an extraordinary 5-bedroom duplex penthouse. Select apartments come with private swimming pools, while all units feature branded kitchen appliances, high ceilings, floor-to-ceiling insulated windows, and smart home technology.

Residents enjoy the convenience of 3 to 7 dedicated parking spaces depending on the property type, with the penthouse offering 10 exclusive spaces. With direct access to Crescent Road, the location ensures seamless connectivity to mainland Dubai, with Dubai International Airport just a 25-minute drive away. Como Residences is the epitome of ultra-luxury living in the heart of Palm Jumeirah.

Finance is available on this property through Premier Property Finance. Call us on +97143233609 for a free consultation.
